<section class="about-story">
  <div class="about-story-inner">
    <div class="section-tag">How it started</div>
    <h2 id="about-story-h2">The spreadsheet that became an app.</h2>
    <p id="about-story-p1">In 2023, trying to figure out whether the Queensland Shared Equity Scheme actually made sense for our budget, we built a spreadsheet. It had 14 tabs, nested formulas, and still couldn't tell us what we owed the government in year 10.</p>
    <p>We started talking to other first home buyers and heard the same story over and over. The scheme is genuinely useful — it lets people who couldn't otherwise afford a deposit get into the market. But it's complex, and the complexity was stopping people from using it confidently.</p>
    <div class="pullquote">
      <p>"We wanted a tool that told you the full cost, the 30-year picture, and the break-even point — all from one place."</p>
    </div>
    <p>So we built EquitySight. It started as an internal tool, went through dozens of iterations shaped by feedback from real buyers, and is now available to anyone navigating the path to homeownership in Australia.</p>
    <p>We're a small team — we answer support tickets ourselves, we ship updates based on real feature requests, and we care deeply about making this genuinely useful. Not startup-speak useful. Actually useful.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about-values">
  <div class="about-values-inner">
    <div class="section-tag">What we believe</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Our values</h2>
    <div class="values-grid">
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🔍</div>
        <h3>Clarity over complexity</h3>
        <p>Property finance doesn't need to be opaque. Every number we show you has a reason, and every calculation is explainable in plain English.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🤝</div>
        <h3>Honest about limitations</h3>
        <p>We're a calculator, not a financial adviser. We're explicit about what our tool can and can't tell you — and we'll always point you to a licensed professional for the big decisions.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🏠</div>
        <h3>Built for buyers</h3>
        <p>Everything we build is shaped by real buyers in the middle of real decisions. We don't ship features we haven't tested with people actually buying property.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🔒</div>
        <h3>Your data, your business</h3>
        <p>We don't sell your data. We don't share your scenarios with third parties. What you model is private, full stop.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🚀</div>
        <h3>Ship and listen</h3>
        <p>We release updates every week. Most features were requested by users. We read every support email and reply within 24 hours.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">🌏</div>
        <h3>Australian focused</h3>
        <p>We're built specifically for the Australian market — state-by-state scheme rules, LMI calculations, stamp duty by state, and suburb growth data from Australian sources.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about-team">
  <div class="about-team-inner">
    <div style="max-width:500px;margin-bottom:48px;">
      <div class="section-tag">The team</div>
      <h2 class="section-title">Small team, big ambitions.</h2>
      <p class="section-sub" style="margin-top:12px;">We're a lean team of builders who have all been through the first-home-buyer experience firsthand.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="team-grid">

        <div class="team-name">Alex Chen</div>

        <div class="team-bio">B.Eng (Software), Queensland University of Technology. 10 years building financial tooling across two ASX-listed fintechs before co-founding EquitySight. Bought his first home in Brisbane through the Queensland Shared Equity Scheme in 2023 — that experience, and the spreadsheet it required, became the seed of this product. Writes the build pipeline, the mortgage math, and every calculator on the site. Contact: <a href="mailto:alex@equitysight.app">alex@equitysight.app</a>.</div>
      </div>

        <div class="team-bio">B.Des (Interaction), University of Technology Sydney. Eight years as a UX lead at a Big Four Australian bank, where she ran user research on mortgage-origination and home-loan-repayment tooling. Owns the editorial voice on EquitySight, the usability of every calculator, and the methodology behind how we explain complex financial concepts in plain English. Contact: <a href="mailto:sarah@equitysight.app">sarah@equitysight.app</a>.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="team-card">
        <div class="team-avatar">👨‍💼</div>
        <div class="team-name">James Patel</div>
        <div class="team-role">Head of Property Data</div>
        <div class="team-bio">B.Prop (Valuation), RMIT. Certified Practising Valuer with 12 years at two national valuation firms, covering residential portfolios across Victoria and New South Wales. Curates our ABS 2021 Census ingest, owns the suburb-scoring methodology and the comparison-table deltas, and reviews every change to the scoring formula before it ships. Contact: <a href="mailto:james@equitysight.app">james@equitysight.app</a>.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="about-values" style="border-top:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.08);">
  <div class="about-values-inner">
    <div class="section-tag">Editorial standards</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">How we keep ourselves honest.</h2>
    <p class="section-sub" style="margin-top:12px;max-width:640px;">Every number on EquitySight is computed deterministically from published government data. Nothing is hand-written per suburb, nothing is generated by a chatbot, and nothing is paid for by a third party. We publish the exact formulas and the exact data sources so any reader can reproduce our output.</p>
    <div class="values-grid" style="margin-top:32px;">
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">📐</div>
        <h3>Published methodology</h3>
        <p>Every score, strategy verdict and comparison delta is documented formula-by-formula. Read the <a href="/methodology">EquitySight Methodology</a> to see exactly how the numbers are computed, including the cash-flow coverage ratio, rate-sensitivity stress test and rental-stress threshold.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">📚</div>
        <h3>Attributed data sources</h3>
        <p>The ABS 2021 Census, Australia Post postcode file, OpenStreetMap amenities and the RBA cash-rate feed — with licensing, refresh cadence and attribution — are listed on the <a href="/data-sources">Data Sources &amp; Attribution page</a>. We do not accept paid data from agents or developers.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="value-card">
        <div class="value-icon">✅</div>
        <h3>Corrections policy</h3>
        <p>If you spot an error on any suburb page or calculator, email <a href="mailto:support@equitysight.app">support@equitysight.app</a>. Confirmed corrections are logged publicly in the methodology change log, with the date and the field that changed — so you can see exactly what was fixed.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

      <div class="site-logo-mark"><img src="/images/icon-dark.svg" alt="EquitySight" width="52" height="52"></div>
      <div class="site-logo-text"><span class="site-logo-name">EquitySight</span><span class="site-logo-tld">.app</span></div>
    </a>
    <ul class="site-nav-links">
      <li><a href="/pricing">Pricing</a></li>
      <li><a href="/contact">Support</a></li>
      <li><a href="/about">About</a></li>

</nav>

<!-- Custom Confirm/Alert Dialog -->
<div class="custom-dialog-overlay" id="custom-dialog-overlay">
  <div class="custom-dialog" id="custom-dialog">
    <div class="custom-dialog-header" id="custom-dialog-header">
      <span class="custom-dialog-icon" id="custom-dialog-icon"></span>
      <div class="custom-dialog-title" id="custom-dialog-title"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="custom-dialog-body" id="custom-dialog-body">
      <div id="custom-dialog-message"></div>
      <input type="password" class="custom-dialog-input" id="custom-dialog-input" placeholder="" style="display:none;">
    </div>
    <div class="custom-dialog-footer" id="custom-dialog-footer">
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="custom-dialog-cancel">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn-admin" id="custom-dialog-confirm">Confirm</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Stat Popup Modal -->
<div class="stat-popup-overlay" id="stat-popup-overlay">
  <div class="stat-popup">
    <div class="stat-popup-head">
      <div>
        <div class="stat-popup-title" id="stat-popup-title">Stat</div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-family:var(--font-mono);margin-top:2px;" id="stat-popup-desc"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;">
        <div class="stat-popup-value" id="stat-popup-value">—</div>
        <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="stat-popup-close-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 12px;flex-shrink:0;">✕ Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-popup-body">
      <div class="stat-popup-filter-bar">
        <span style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);letter-spacing:0.5px;">SHOW:</span>
        <button class="stat-popup-filter-btn" data-range="7" active">7 days</button>
        <button class="stat-popup-filter-btn" data-range="14"">14 days</button>
        <button class="stat-popup-filter-btn" data-range="30"">30 days</button>
        <span style="margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--slate);" id="stat-popup-range-label"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-popup-chart" id="stat-popup-chart"></div>
      <div class="stat-popup-stats-row" id="stat-popup-stats-row"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Reset Password Modal -->
<div class="reset-modal-overlay" id="reset-modal-overlay" style="z-index:3000;">
  <div class="reset-modal">
    <h3>Reset Password</h3>
    <p id="reset-modal-desc">Set a new password for this account.</p>
    <div class="config-field">
      <label class="config-label">New Password</label>
      <input type="password" class="config-input" id="reset-new-pw" placeholder="Minimum 8 characters">
    </div>
    <div id="reset-modal-status" class="admin-status"></div>
    <div class="reset-modal-btns">
      <button class="btn-admin" id="reset-pw-confirm-btn">Set Password</button>
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="reset-modal-cancel-btn">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="reset-back-btn" style="display:none;">← Back to User</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="main-content"></div>
<div class="admin-layout" id="admin-layout" style="display:none">

  <div class="admin-header">
    <div>
      <h1>Admin Dashboard</h1>
      <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">EquitySight.app system management</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">
      <span class="admin-badge">🔒 Admin</span>
      <a href="/app" class="btn-admin-outline" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">← Back to App</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Stats row — always visible outside tabs -->
  <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">
    <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);">Overview</div>
    <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="stats-refresh-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 14px;" title="Manually refresh all stats and graphs">↻ Refresh Stats</button>
  </div>
  <div class="admin-stats" id="admin-stats">
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="total" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Total Users</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">All registered accounts</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-total"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="free" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-free"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Free Plan</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">1 saved scenario limit</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-free"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="pro" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-pro"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Pro Plan</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--stat);margin-top:4px;">Unlimited + PDF + Projection</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-pro"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="adviser" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-adviser"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Adviser Plan</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Multi-client + white-label</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-adviser"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="revenue" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-revenue"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Revenue Est.</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Monthly AUD (Pro + Adviser) <span id="stat-discount-note" style="display:none;color:#C9A84C;" title="Some users have active discounts — actual revenue may be lower"></span></div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-revenue"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="avg" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-avg-scenarios"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Avg Scenarios</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Scenario lists per user</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-avg"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="total-scenarios" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-total-scenarios"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Total Scenarios</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Individual saved scenarios</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-total-scenarios"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="shared" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-shared"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Shared Scenarios</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Scenarios shared between users</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-shared"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="errors" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-errors"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Client Errors</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">JS errors in error log</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-errors"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" data-stat="db-keys" title="Click to expand">
      <div class="stat-value" id="stat-db-keys"><div class="stat-spinner"></div></div>
      <div class="stat-label">Database Keys</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Total Redis keys stored</div>
      <div class="stat-chart" id="stat-chart-db-keys"><div class="stat-chart-loading"></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Tabs -->
  <div class="admin-tabs">
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="users">Users</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="scenarios">Scenarios</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="schemes">Gov Schemes</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="growth">Growth Data</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="database">Database</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="client-errors">Error Log</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="settings">Settings</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="features">Features</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="integrations">Integrations</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="branding">Branding</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="email-templates">Email Templates</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="about-page">About Page</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="legal-pages">Legal Pages</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="suburbs">Suburbs</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="blog">Blog</button>
    <button class="admin-tab" data-tab="moderation">Moderation</button>
  </div>

  <!-- USERS TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section active" id="tab-users">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>All Accounts</h3>
        <div class="filter-bar">
          <input class="filter-input" id="user-search" placeholder="Search email or name…">
          <select class="filter-select" id="plan-filter">
            <option value="">All plans</option>
            <option value="free">Free</option>
            <option value="pro">Pro</option>
            <option value="adviser">Adviser</option>
          </select>
          <select class="filter-select" id="login-filter" title="Filter by login activity">
            <option value="">All users</option>
            <option value="active-30">Active last 30d</option>
            <option value="active-7">Active last 7d</option>
            <option value="never">Never logged in</option>
          </select>
          <select class="filter-select" id="sort-filter" title="Sort users">
            <option value="joined-desc">Joined: newest first</option>
            <option value="joined-asc">Joined: oldest first</option>
            <option value="login-desc">Last login: newest first</option>
            <option value="login-asc">Last login: oldest first</option>
          </select>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="load-users-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">↻ Refresh</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="users-table-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;">
        <table class="user-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Name</th>
              <th>Email</th>
              <th>Plan</th>
              <th>Joined</th>
              <th>Last Login</th>
              <th>Role</th>
              <th>Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="users-tbody">
            <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;color:var(--slate);padding:32px;font-style:italic;">Loading users…</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="users-status" class="admin-status"></div>

    <!-- Deleted Users -->
    <div class="admin-card" style="margin-top:20px;">
      <div class="admin-card-head" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;">
        <div>
          <h3 style="margin:0;display:inline;">Deleted Users</h3>
          <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-left:8px;">Soft-deleted accounts (retained 90 days)</span>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-admin" id="load-deleted-users-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">↻ Refresh</button>
      </div>
      <div id="deleted-users-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;">
        <table class="user-table">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Name</th>
              <th>Email</th>
              <th>Plan</th>
              <th>Joined</th>
              <th>Deleted</th>
              <th>Deleted By</th>
              <th>Reason</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="deleted-users-tbody">
            <tr><td colspan="7" style="text-align:center;color:var(--slate);padding:24px;font-style:italic;">Click refresh to load</td></tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="deleted-users-status" class="admin-status"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- CLIENT ERROR LOG TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-client-errors">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Client Error Log</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">JS errors and unhandled promise rejections captured from user browsers</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:16px 20px 4px;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.6;">
          Shows up to the 500 most recent errors. Useful for diagnosing CSS/JS loading issues and runtime exceptions in production.
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;">
          <button class="btn-admin" id="ce-refresh-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">↻ Refresh</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="ce-clear-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;color:#c45a5a;border-color:rgba(196,90,90,0.4);">🗑 Clear All</button>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="ce-sync-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">⬆ Sync to GitHub</button>
        </div>
        <div id="client-errors-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;">
          <div id="client-errors-loading" style="padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate);font-size:13px;">Click refresh to load errors.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- SETTINGS TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-settings">

    <!-- Site Identity -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Site Identity</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Branding &amp; contact details shown across the site</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div class="config-grid" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Site Name</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-site-name" placeholder="EquitySight.app">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Displayed in the browser tab and header</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Site Tagline</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-site-tagline" placeholder="Shared Equity Property Calculator">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Short description shown on the landing page</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Support Email</label>
            <input type="email" class="config-input" id="cfg-support-email" placeholder="support@equitysight.app">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Shown in footers and error messages</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Site URL</label>
            <input type="url" class="config-input" id="cfg-site-url" placeholder="https://equitysight.app">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Used in emails and canonical links</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Discord / Community Link</label>
            <input type="url" class="config-input" id="cfg-discord" placeholder="https://discord.gg/…">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Shown in the footer community section</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Twitter / X Handle</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-twitter" placeholder="@equitysight">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Linked in the footer social section</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Announcement Banner -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Announcement Banner</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Displays a sitewide notice bar at the top of the app</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <label class="config-label">Banner Message (leave blank to hide)</label>
          <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-banner" placeholder="e.g. New: 30-year equity projections now available!">
        </div>
        <div class="config-grid" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Banner Type</label>
            <select class="config-input" id="cfg-banner-type">
              <option value="info">Info (blue)</option>
              <option value="success">Success (green)</option>
              <option value="warning">Warning (yellow)</option>
              <option value="danger">Danger (red)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Expiry Date (optional)</label>
            <input type="date" class="config-input" id="cfg-banner-expiry">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="cfg-banner-preview" style="display:none;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Access Control -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Access Control</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Control who can access the site and how accounts are managed</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div class="config-grid" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-maintenance" style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              Maintenance Mode
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Show maintenance page to all non-admin visitors</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-allow-signups" checked style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              Allow New Signups
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Disable to close registration temporarily</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-guest-access" checked style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              Allow Guest Access
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Allow non-signed-in users to use the calculator</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Maintenance Message</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-maintenance-msg" placeholder="We'll be back shortly — upgrading our systems.">
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Min Password Length</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-min-pw" value="8" min="6" max="32">
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Restrict Signups to Email Domain</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="cfg-email-domain" placeholder="e.g. company.com (blank = anyone)">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;">
      <button class="btn-admin" id="save-config-btn">Save Settings</button>
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="export-config-btn">Export JSON</button>
    </div>
    <div id="config-status" class="admin-status"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- FEATURES TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-features">

    <!-- Feature Flags -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Feature Flags</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Enable or disable features globally across the app</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div class="config-grid">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-enable-pdf" checked style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              PDF Export (Pro)
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Allows Pro &amp; Adviser users to download property reports as PDF. Uncheck to disable for all users.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-enable-proj" checked style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              30-Year Projection (Pro)
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Shows the 30-year equity growth chart. Uncheck to hide the Projection tab for all users.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
              <input type="checkbox" id="cfg-enable-referral" style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:var(--gold);">
              Referral Program
            </label>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Enables the referral link system — users earn free Pro days when friends sign up.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Referral Bonus (days free)</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-referral-bonus" value="30" min="1" max="365">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Number of free Pro days awarded to a referrer when their link converts to a signup.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">

            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-max-upload" value="5" min="1" max="50">

          </div>

            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-session-ttl" value="30" min="1" max="365">

          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Plan Limits & Pricing -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Plan Limits &amp; Pricing</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Controls how many scenarios each plan can save and what prices show on the Pricing page</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div class="config-grid">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Free — Scenario Limit</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-free-limit" value="1" min="1" max="20">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Max saved property scenarios for free accounts. Saving more will prompt an upgrade.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Pro — Scenario Limit (-1 = unlimited)</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-pro-limit" value="-1" min="-1" max="999">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Set to -1 for unlimited. Pro users can save and compare as many properties as they like.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Pro Monthly Price (AUD $)</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-pro-monthly" value="9" min="0" max="99999999">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Displayed on the Pricing page. Must match your Stripe price configuration.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Pro Annual Price (AUD $)</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-pro-annual" value="86" min="0" max="99999999">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Yearly Pro price shown on Pricing page. Typically ~20% discount vs monthly.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Adviser Monthly Price (AUD $)</label>
            <input type="number" class="config-input" id="cfg-adviser-monthly" value="29" min="0" max="99999999">
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:4px;">Displayed on the Pricing page for the Adviser tier. Includes multi-client access.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;">
      <button class="btn-admin" id="save-features-btn">Save Features</button>
    </div>
    <div id="features-status" class="admin-status"></div>

  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-integrations">

    <!-- Stripe Integration -->

      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div style="background:rgba(201,168,76,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:20px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;">
          Store sensitive keys (sk_live_…, whsec_…) only in <strong>Netlify → Site Settings → Environment Variables</strong> — never in this form.
        </div>
        <div class="config-grid">
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Stripe Publishable Key</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="stripe-pub-key" placeholder="pk_live_…">

          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Pro Monthly Price ID</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="stripe-pro-monthly" placeholder="price_…">
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">
            <label class="config-label">Pro Annual Price ID</label>
            <input type="text" class="config-input" id="stripe-pro-annual" placeholder="price_…">
          </div>
          <div class="config-field">

          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.8;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.03);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);">
          <strong>Setup:</strong> Add <code>STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY</code>, <code>STRIPE_SECRET_KEY</code>, <code>STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET</code> to Netlify env vars.
          Webhook endpoint: <code>/.netlify/functions/stripe</code> — events: <code>checkout.session.completed</code>, <code>customer.subscription.deleted</code>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

          <label class="config-label">Google Client ID</label>
          <input type="text" class="config-input" id="google-client-id" placeholder="123456789-abc….apps.googleusercontent.com">

          <strong>Setup:</strong> Go to <a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials" target="_blank" style="color:var(--gold);">Google Cloud Console → APIs &amp; Services → Credentials</a> → Create OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web application). Add <code>https://equitysight.app</code> as an authorised JavaScript origin. Paste the Client ID above and save. Optionally set <code>GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID</code> in Netlify env vars for server-side verification.<br>Leave blank to hide the Google Sign-In button.
        </div>
      </div>

          <span class="site-logo" style="pointer-events:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;">

              <button type="button" class="brand-theme-swatch" data-theme="navy"       title="Deep Navy"       style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:#1C1C1E;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;"><span style="display:inline-flex;gap:3px;"><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#0D1B2A;"></span><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#4B88C8;"></span></span>Deep Navy</button>
              <button type="button" class="brand-theme-swatch" data-theme="forest"     title="Forest Green"    style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:#1C1C1E;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;"><span style="display:inline-flex;gap:3px;"><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#0F2318;"></span><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#5A9E6F;"></span></span>Forest Green</button>
              <button type="button" class="brand-theme-swatch" data-theme="terracotta" title="Terracotta"       style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:#1C1C1E;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;"><span style="display:inline-flex;gap:3px;"><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#2B1407;"></span><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#C4714A;"></span></span>Terracotta</button>
              <button type="button" class="brand-theme-swatch" data-theme="indigo"     title="Midnight Indigo" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:#1C1C1E;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;"><span style="display:inline-flex;gap:3px;"><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#12102A;"></span><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#7B6FD0;"></span></span>Midnight Indigo</button>
              <button type="button" class="brand-theme-swatch" data-theme="slate"      title="Cool Slate"      style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:#1C1C1E;transition:border-color 0.15s,box-shadow 0.15s;"><span style="display:inline-flex;gap:3px;"><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#14202E;"></span><span style="display:block;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;background:#6B8FAF;"></span></span>Cool Slate</button>
            </div>

          Configure government schemes and grants here. Each scheme can be a <strong>Shared Equity</strong> (government co-owns a %), a <strong>Grant</strong> (fixed dollar amount), an <strong>LMI Waiver</strong> (removes Lenders Mortgage Insurance), or <strong>Mixed</strong> (combination). Add suburb-specific bonuses and income thresholds as needed. Click a scheme header to expand/collapse it.

  <!-- DATABASE TAB -->
  <!-- GROWTH DATA TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-growth">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Suburb Growth Cache</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Shared growth rates looked up by users — cached for 30 days, then refreshed automatically</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:16px 20px 4px;">
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:12px;line-height:1.6;">
          When a user looks up suburb growth data it is stored here so all users benefit from the same data. Entries automatically expire after 30 days to stay current.
          You can manually add, edit or delete entries below.
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;align-items:center;">
          <button class="btn-admin" id="load-growth-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">↻ Refresh</button>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="show-add-growth-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">+ Add Entry</button>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="import-growth-csv-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;" title="CSV format: suburb,state,rate,note (header row optional)">⬆ Import CSV</button>
          <input type="file" id="growth-csv-input" accept=".csv,text/csv" style="display:none;">
          <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);">CSV columns: suburb, state, rate, note</span>
        </div>
        <div id="growth-add-form" style="display:none;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.15);border-radius:6px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px;">
          <div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--gold);">Add / Override Growth Entry</div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;">
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">
              <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Suburb</label>
              <input id="growth-add-suburb" class="config-input" placeholder="e.g. Kedron" style="width:160px;">
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">
              <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">State</label>
              <select id="growth-add-state" class="config-input" style="width:90px;">
                <option>QLD</option><option>NSW</option><option>VIC</option><option>SA</option>
                <option>WA</option><option>TAS</option><option>NT</option><option>ACT</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">
              <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Rate % p.a.</label>
              <input id="growth-add-rate" class="config-input" type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="25" placeholder="6.5" style="width:90px;">
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;">
              <label style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Note (optional)</label>
              <input id="growth-add-note" class="config-input" placeholder="historical estimate" style="width:200px;">
            </div>
            <button class="btn-admin" id="save-growth-entry-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">Save</button>
            <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="hide-growth-entry-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div id="growth-table-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;">
          <div id="growth-loading" style="padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate);font-size:13px;">Loading…</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-database">
    <!-- Database Browser -->
    <div class="admin-card" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Database Browser</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Browse and filter all Redis keys for debugging</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:20px;">
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <input type="text" id="db-filter-input" placeholder="Filter pattern (e.g. user:* or token:*)" style="flex:1;min-width:200px;padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.12);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--charcoal);">
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="db-browse-btn">Browse</button>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="*" style="font-size:10px;">All</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="user:*" style="font-size:10px;">Users</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="token:*" style="font-size:10px;">Tokens</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="profile:*" style="font-size:10px;">Profiles</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="scenarios:*" style="font-size:10px;">Scenarios</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="config:*" style="font-size:10px;">Config</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="stats:*" style="font-size:10px;">Stats</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="email-template:*" style="font-size:10px;">Email Templates</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="growth:*" style="font-size:10px;">Growth</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-sm" data-db-filter="client-errors" style="font-size:10px;">Errors</button>
        </div>
        <div id="db-browse-info" style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:12px;"></div>
        <div id="db-browse-results" style="max-height:600px;overflow-y:auto;"></div>
        <div id="db-browse-pager" style="margin-top:12px;text-align:center;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Database Maintenance -->
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Database Maintenance</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Purge old or orphaned data from the database</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div style="display:grid;gap:16px;">
          <div style="background:rgba(196,90,90,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(196,90,90,0.15);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:16px 20px;">
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--charcoal);">🗑 Purge Expired Sessions</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7;">Remove all login tokens that have expired. Active users won't be affected — only stale sessions older than the TTL are removed.</div>
            <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="purge-sessions-btn">Purge Expired Sessions</button>
          </div>
          <div style="background:rgba(196,90,90,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(196,90,90,0.15);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:16px 20px;">
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--charcoal);">🗑 Purge Orphaned Profiles</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7;">Remove profile data for accounts that no longer exist. Safe to run — only deletes profiles with no matching user account.</div>
            <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="purge-profiles-btn">Purge Orphaned Profiles</button>
          </div>
          <div style="background:rgba(196,90,90,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(196,90,90,0.15);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:16px 20px;">
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--charcoal);">🗑 Purge Orphaned Scenarios</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7;">Remove saved scenarios for accounts that no longer exist. This frees up storage space without affecting active user data.</div>
            <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="purge-scenarios-btn">Purge Orphaned Scenarios</button>
          </div>
          <div style="background:rgba(196,90,90,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(196,90,90,0.25);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:16px 20px;">
            <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--risk-red);">⚠ Export All User Data</div>
            <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.7;">Download a JSON export of all user accounts (no passwords). Useful for backup or migration purposes.</div>
            <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="export-users-btn">Export User Data JSON</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="database-status" class="admin-status"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- EMAIL TEMPLATES TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-email-templates">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Email Templates</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Customise the emails sent by EquitySight. Use <code style="background:rgba(0,0,0,0.06);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:11px;">{{variable}}</code> placeholders listed for each template.</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div style="margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <select id="et-type-select" class="config-input" style="width:240px;font-size:13px;">
            <option value="verification">Verification Code Email</option>
            <option value="welcome">Welcome Email</option>
            <option value="subscription">Subscription / Plan Update</option>
            <option value="security_alert">Security Alert</option>
            <option value="promotional">Promotional / Feature Update</option>
            <option value="password_reset">Password Reset</option>
            <option value="scenario_shared">Scenario Shared (Existing User)</option>
            <option value="scenario_invite">Scenario Invite (New User)</option>
          </select>
          <span id="et-custom-badge" style="display:none;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;background:rgba(201,168,76,0.15);color:#C9A84C;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3);border-radius:3px;padding:2px 8px;">CUSTOMISED</span>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="reset-et-btn" style="margin-left:auto;">Reset to Default</button>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-bottom:10px;">
          <label class="config-label">Available variables: <span id="et-vars" style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);"></span></label>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-bottom:14px;">
          <label class="config-label">Subject</label>
          <input class="config-input" id="et-subject" type="text" style="width:100%;" placeholder="Email subject line">
        </div>
        <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <label class="config-label">HTML Body</label>
          <textarea id="et-html" class="config-input" style="width:100%;min-height:220px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5;" placeholder="HTML content…"></textarea>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="save-et-btn">Save Template</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="preview-et-btn">Preview</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="et-test-btn">Send Test Email</button>
          <div id="et-status" class="admin-status" style="margin:0;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ABOUT PAGE TAB -->
  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-about-page">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>About Page</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Edit the hero section and main story text. Changes appear immediately on about.html.</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px;">
        <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">
          <label class="config-label">Hero Headline</label>
          <input class="config-input" id="about-hero-h1" type="text" style="width:100%;" placeholder="Built by buyers,&#10;for buyers.">

  <div class="admin-section" id="tab-suburbs">
    <div class="admin-card">
      <div class="admin-card-head">
        <h3>Suburb Pages</h3>
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);">Manage 14,500+ suburb insight pages — real ABS population data + postcodes</span>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:16px 20px;">
        <!-- Status cards -->
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px;">
          <div class="admin-stat-card">
            <div class="admin-stat-label">Total Suburbs</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" id="suburbs-total">—</div>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-stat-card">
            <div class="admin-stat-label">Indexed (Featured)</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" id="suburbs-indexed">—</div>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-stat-card">
            <div class="admin-stat-label">Noindexed</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" id="suburbs-noindexed">—</div>
          </div>

            <div class="admin-stat-label">With Postcodes</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" id="suburbs-with-pc">—</div>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-stat-card">
            <div class="admin-stat-label">Data Source</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" style="font-size:13px;">ABS 2021 Census</div>
          </div>
          <div class="admin-stat-card">
            <div class="admin-stat-label">Last Page Build</div>
            <div class="admin-stat-value" id="suburbs-last-build" style="font-size:13px;">—</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Index report (AdSense gate) -->
        <div id="suburbs-index-report" style="background:rgba(201,168,76,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.15);border-radius:6px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:20px;display:none;">
          <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;">AdSense indexing gate</div>
          <div id="suburbs-index-report-body" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.6;"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Actions -->
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:20px;align-items:center;">
          <button class="btn-admin" id="trigger-suburb-rebuild-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">🔄 Rebuild Suburb Pages</button>
          <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);max-width:360px;line-height:1.5;">Triggers a Netlify deploy with REBUILD_SUBURBS=true. Requires a deploy hook URL in Configuration → Deploy Hook.</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Deploy hook config -->
        <div style="background:rgba(201,168,76,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.15);border-radius:6px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:20px;">
          <div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:8px;">Deploy Hook URL</div>
          <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.5;">
            Create a deploy hook in Netlify → Site Configuration → Build hooks. Paste the URL here. The rebuild button uses this to trigger deploys.
          </div>
          <!-- Edit mode -->
          <div id="suburbs-hook-edit" style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;">
            <input id="suburbs-deploy-hook" class="config-input" placeholder="https://api.netlify.com/build_hooks/..." style="flex:1;font-size:12px;">
            <button class="btn-admin" id="save-suburb-hook-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">Save</button>
          </div>
          <!-- Saved display mode (hidden by default) -->
          <div id="suburbs-hook-saved" style="display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
            <div id="suburbs-hook-display" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);font-family:var(--font-mono);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">—</div>
            <button class="btn-admin" id="edit-suburb-hook-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:7px 14px;">Edit</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- State breakdown -->
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:10px;">SUBURBS BY STATE</div>
        <div id="suburbs-state-breakdown" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr));gap:8px;margin-bottom:20px;"></div>

        <!-- Search -->
        <div style="margin-bottom:12px;">
          <input id="suburbs-admin-search" class="config-input" placeholder="Search suburbs by name or postcode..." style="width:100%;max-width:400px;font-size:13px;">
        </div>

        <!-- Results table -->
        <div id="suburbs-table-wrap" style="overflow-x:auto;max-height:500px;overflow-y:auto;">
          <div id="suburbs-loading" style="padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--slate);font-size:13px;">Click a state or search to browse suburbs</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
