```html
    </label>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;">
      <input type="checkbox" id="inp-new-prop" style="width:15px;height:15px;cursor:pointer;accent-color:var(--gold);">
      <span style="font-size:12px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.7);">New property / off the plan</span>
    </label>
  </div>

  <hr class="div">
  <!-- PURCHASE COSTS — dynamic -->
  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
    <div class="s-head" style="margin-bottom:0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;">Purchase Costs</div>
    <button class="add-cost-btn" id="add-cost-purchase-btn" style="width:auto;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;">＋ Add</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cost-items-list" id="cost-items-purchase">
    <!-- Purchase costs seeded in JS -->
  </div>

  <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:8px;">
    <div class="s-head" style="margin-bottom:0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--terracotta-light);">Move-Out Costs</div>
    <button class="add-cost-btn" id="add-cost-moveout-btn" style="width:auto;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;">＋ Add</button>
  </div>
  <div class="cost-items-list" id="cost-items-moveout">
    <!-- Move-out costs seeded in JS -->
  </div>

  <div id="reno-sidebar-section" style="display:none;">
  <div class="ig" style="pointer-events:none;opacity:0.7;display:none;">
    <div class="il">Reno Total <span id="lbl-reno-total">$21,000</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="ig" style="display:none;">
    <div class="il">Contingency % <span id="lbl-cont">15%</span></div>
    <div class="iw"><input type="number" class="pct" id="inp-cont" value="0" min="0" max="50" step="1"><span class="isfx">%</span></div>
    <input type="range" id="rng-cont" min="0" max="50" step="1" value="0">
  </div>
  </div>

  <div id="rent-sidebar-section">
  <div class="ig">
    <div class="il">Current Rent/wk <span id="lbl-rent">$450</span></div>
    <div class="iw"><span class="ipfx">$</span><input type="number" id="inp-rent" value="0" min="0" max="5000" step="10"></div>
    <input type="range" id="rng-rent" min="0" max="2000" step="10" value="0">
  </div>
  <div class="ig">
    <div class="il">Overlap Weeks <span id="lbl-weeks">4</span></div>
    <div class="iw"><input type="number" id="inp-weeks" value="0" min="0" max="26" step="1"></div>
    <input type="range" id="rng-weeks" min="0" max="26" step="1" value="0">
  </div>
  </div>

  <div id="sidebar-alert"></div>  </div>

</div>

<!-- ══════ CONTENT ══════ -->
<div class="content">

  <!-- ══ SCENARIOS MODAL ══ -->
  <div id="scenarios-modal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);justify-content:center;padding:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top,8px)) 12px 24px;overflow-y:auto;">
    <div style="position:relative;margin:auto;width:min(760px,100%);max-height:100%;background:var(--warm-white);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">

      <!-- Header -->
      <div style="background:var(--charcoal);padding:16px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0;gap:12px;">
        <div>
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:2px;">SAVED SCENARIOS</div>
          <div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--cream);">Property Library <span id="lib-count" style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.4);margin-left:6px;"></span></div>
        </div>
        <button id="close-scenarios-modal-btn" style="width:32px;height:32px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:3px;color:var(--cream);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;">✕</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Filter bar -->
      <div style="background:var(--charcoal-soft);padding:10px 20px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);overflow-x:auto;">
        <span style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.4);letter-spacing:1px;margin-right:2px;flex-shrink:0;">FILTER:</span>
        <button class="lib-filter active" data-filter="all">All</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="browsing">👀 Browsing</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="for-sale">🏷 For Sale</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="auction">🔨 Auction</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="offered">📝 Offered</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="under-offer">⏳ Under Offer</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="unconditional">✅ Unconditional</button>
        <button class="lib-filter" data-filter="sold">🔴 Sold</button>
      </div>

      <!-- List -->
      <div id="scenarios-list" style="overflow-y:auto;flex:1;min-height:0;padding:12px 20px;">
        <div id="scenarios-empty" style="display:none;text-align:center;padding:48px 20px;color:var(--slate);">
          <div style="font-size:40px;margin-bottom:10px;">🏠</div>
          <div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:6px;">No saved scenarios yet</div>
          <div style="font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;">Fill in your property details and click <strong>Save</strong> to save your first property.</div>
        </div>
        <div id="scenarios-grid"></div>

        <!-- Shared with me section -->
        <div id="shared-section" style="display:none;margin-top:20px;">
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);padding:8px 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.2);margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
            <span>👥 Shared with me</span>
            <span id="shared-count" style="color:rgba(201,168,76,0.5);font-size:11px;"></span>
          </div>
          <div id="shared-grid"></div>
        </div>

        <!-- Admin: All users section -->
        <div id="admin-all-section" style="display:none;margin-top:20px;">
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--sky);padding:8px 0 6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(91,143,171,0.25);margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
            <span>🔑 All Users' Scenarios</span>
            <span id="admin-all-count" style="color:rgba(91,143,171,0.5);font-size:11px;"></span>
          </div>
          <div id="admin-all-grid"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══ SHARE SCENARIO MODAL ══ -->
  <div id="share-modal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3100;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);">
    <div style="position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(440px,92vw);background:var(--warm-white);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);">
      <div style="background:var(--charcoal);padding:16px 20px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:3px;">SHARE SCENARIO</div>
        <div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:white;">Share with another user</div>
        <div id="share-scenario-addr" style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.5);margin-top:4px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:20px;">
        <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:14px;">The person you share with can view and load this scenario. Enter their EquitySight account email.</p>
        <div style="margin-bottom:8px;">
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:5px;">Their email address</div>
          <input id="share-email-input" type="email" placeholder="user@example.com"
            style="width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:3px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-size:14px;outline:none;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);color:var(--charcoal);">
        </div>
        <div id="share-also-list" style="display:none;margin-bottom:12px;">
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:5px;">Currently shared with:</div>
          <div id="share-also-names" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.8;"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="share-status" style="font-size:12px;min-height:18px;margin-bottom:12px;"></div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;">
          <button id="share-confirm-btn" style="flex:1;padding:10px;background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--cream);border:none;border-radius:3px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">↗ Share</button>
          <button id="cancel-share-btn" style="flex:1;padding:10px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.07);color:var(--slate);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.12);border-radius:3px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══ LIBRARY ACTIONS POPUP ══ -->
  <div id="lib-actions-overlay" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2500;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);">
    <div id="lib-actions-popup" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--warm-white);border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 -8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);max-width:480px;margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);">
      <div style="padding:16px 20px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.08);">
        <div id="lib-actions-addr" style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;"></div>
        <div id="lib-actions-meta" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:2px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:8px 12px;">
        <button id="lib-action-load" class="lib-action-btn" style="width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:none;border:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--charcoal);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">
          <span style="font-size:20px;">📂</span> Load Scenario
        </button>
        <button id="lib-action-export" class="lib-action-btn" style="width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:none;border:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--charcoal);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">
          <span style="font-size:20px;">📄</span> Export PDF
        </button>
        <button id="lib-action-share" class="lib-action-btn" style="width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:none;border:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--charcoal);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">
          <span style="font-size:20px;">↗</span> Share
        </button>
        <button id="lib-action-delete" class="lib-action-btn" style="width:100%;padding:14px 16px;background:none;border:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:14px;color:var(--risk-red);cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;">
          <span style="font-size:20px;">🗑</span> Delete
        </button>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:4px 12px 12px;">
        <button id="lib-action-cancel" style="width:100%;padding:12px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);border-radius:10px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══ CONFIRM LOAD MODAL ══ -->
  <div id="confirm-modal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);">
    <div style="position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(420px,90vw);background:var(--warm-white);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 16px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);">
      <div style="background:var(--terracotta);padding:16px 20px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);margin-bottom:3px;">CONFIRM LOAD</div>
        <div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:white;">Replace current scenario?</div>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:20px;">
        <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--slate);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:16px;">Loading <strong id="confirm-name" style="color:var(--charcoal);">this scenario</strong> will replace all your current values. Any unsaved changes will be lost.</p>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;">
          <button id="confirm-load-btn" style="flex:1;padding:10px;background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--cream);border:none;border-radius:3px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">✓ Yes, Load It</button>
          <button id="cancel-confirm-modal-btn" style="flex:1;padding:10px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.07);color:var(--slate);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.12);border-radius:3px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ══ CUSTOM DIALOG (replaces browser confirm/alert/prompt) ══ -->
  <div id="app-dialog-overlay" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);align-items:center;justify-content:center;animation:appDialogFadeIn 0.15s ease;">
    <div id="app-dialog-box">
      <div id="app-dialog-header">
        <span id="app-dialog-icon"></span>
        <div id="app-dialog-title"></div>
      </div>
      <div id="app-dialog-body">
        <div id="app-dialog-message"></div>
        <input type="password" id="app-dialog-input" placeholder="" style="display:none;">
      </div>
      <div id="app-dialog-footer">
        <button class="app-dialog-btn app-dialog-btn-cancel" id="app-dialog-cancel">Cancel</button>
        <button class="app-dialog-btn app-dialog-btn-confirm" id="app-dialog-confirm">Confirm</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <main>

    <!-- TAB 0: PROPERTY DETAILS -->
    <div class="section active" id="property">
      <div class="sl">Property Details</div>

      <!-- Photo upload + address card -->
      <div class="prop-top-grid" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:14px;align-items:start;">

        <!-- Photo upload big zone -->
        <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden;">
          <div class="ca" style="background:var(--terracotta)"></div>
          <div id="prop-photo-big-wrap" style="position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:var(--charcoal);cursor:pointer;">
            <input type="file" id="pd-file-input" accept="image/*" style="display:none">
            <img id="pd-photo-big" src="" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:none;position:absolute;top:0;left:0;">
            <div id="pd-upload-prompt" style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.5);transition:background 0.2s;">
              <div style="font-size:36px;">📷</div>
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)">Upload Photo</div>
              <div style="font-size:11px;">Click or drag & drop your property image</div>
              <div style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.6;">JPG, PNG, WEBP supported</div>
            </div>
            <div id="pd-photo-overlay" style="display:none;position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;padding:8px 12px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(0,0,0,0.7));font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
              <span id="pd-photo-label"></span>
              <button id="clear-prop-photo-btn" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border:none;color:white;font-size:11px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;">✕ Remove</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="padding:10px 14px 12px;background:var(--warm-white);">
            <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px;">Property Photo</div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
              <input type="text" id="pd-photo-url" placeholder="Or paste image URL here…" style="flex:1;font-size:11px;padding:5px 8px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.05);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.12);border-radius:3px;color:var(--charcoal);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;outline:none;">
              <button id="apply-photo-url-btn" style="background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--gold);border:none;border-radius:3px;padding:5px 10px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">Use URL</button>
            </div>
            <button id="map-img-btn" style="margin-top:7px;width:100%;background:rgba(91,143,171,0.1);border:1px solid rgba(91,143,171,0.3);color:var(--sky);border-radius:3px;padding:6px 10px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;" title="Fetches a satellite/map image of this property using the address from the Property tab">
              🗺️ Get Map Image from Address
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Property details form -->
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="ca" style="background:var(--gold)"></div>
            <h3>Address & Listing</h3>
            <div class="pd-field">
              <label class="pd-label">Street Address</label>
              <div class="addr-wrap">
                <input type="text" id="pd-address" value="" autocomplete="off" maxlength="60" placeholder="e.g. 54 Southampton St">
                <div id="addr-suggestions" class="addr-suggestions"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="g2" style="gap:10px;margin-top:10px;">
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Suburb</label>
                <input type="text" id="pd-suburb" value="" maxlength="30" placeholder="e.g. Kedron">
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">State</label>
                <input type="text" id="pd-state" value="" placeholder="QLD">
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="pd-field" style="margin-top:10px;">
              <label class="pd-label">Listing URL (for your reference)</label>
              <input type="text" id="pd-url" value="" placeholder="https://www.realestate.com.au/...">
            </div>
            <div id="pd-url-link" style="display:none;margin-top:6px;">
              <a id="pd-url-anchor" href="#" target="_blank" style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--sky);text-decoration:none;">🔗 Open listing →</a>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="card">
            <div class="ca" style="background:var(--sky)"></div>
            <h3>Property Stats</h3>
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;">
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Bedrooms</label>
                <div class="pd-stepper">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-bed" data-dir="-1">−</button>
                  <input type="number" id="pd-bed" value="0" min="0" max="10">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-bed" data-dir="1">＋</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Bathrooms</label>
                <div class="pd-stepper">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-bath" data-dir="-1">−</button>
                  <input type="number" id="pd-bath" value="0" min="0" max="10">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-bath" data-dir="1">＋</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Car Spaces</label>
                <div class="pd-stepper">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-car" data-dir="-1">−</button>
                  <input type="number" id="pd-car" value="0" min="0" max="10">
                  <button class="step-btn" data-target="pd-car" data-dir="1">＋</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Land Size (m²)</label>
                <div class="iw" style="position:relative;"><input type="number" id="pd-land" value="" min="0" max="100000" placeholder="e.g. 405" style="padding-left:8px;"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">House Size (m²)</label>
                <div class="iw" style="position:relative;"><input type="number" id="pd-house" value="" min="0" max="10000" placeholder="e.g. 120" style="padding-left:8px;"></div>
              </div>
              <div class="pd-field">
                <label class="pd-label">Year Built</label>
                <div class="iw" style="position:relative;"><input type="number" id="pd-year" value="" min="1800" max="2026" placeholder="e.g. 1985" style="padding-left:8px;"></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Property type & notes -->
      <div class="g2">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="ca" style="background:var(--sage)"></div>

        After settlement you may continue renting your current place for a few weeks while renovating before you move in. During this period you're paying <strong style="color:var(--cream)">both</strong> rent and your mortgage — this calculator shows the exact cost of that overlap and how it affects your remaining cash buffer.
      </div>

          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px"><div style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.12)"></div>After overlap: mortgage only</div>
        </div>

        <!-- Calendar view -->

          <div class="bm"><span>Rent portion</span><span id="ov-rent-pct">41%</span></div>
          <div class="bt" style="height:8px;margin-bottom:10px"><div class="bf" id="ov-rent-bar" style="background:var(--terracotta)"></div></div>
          <div class="bm"><span>Mortgage portion</span><span id="ov-mort-pct">59%</span></div>
          <div class="bt" style="height:8px"><div class="bf" id="ov-mort-bar" style="background:var(--sky)"></div></div>

            <div class="dual-row"><span class="dnm">Mortgage per week</span><span class="dam" id="ov-s-mort">$633</span></div>
            <div class="dual-row"><span class="dnm">Combined per week</span><span class="dam" id="ov-s-combined">$1,083</span></div>

            <div class="dual-row dtot"><span class="dnm">Total Overlap Cost</span><span class="dam" id="ov-s-total">$4,332</span></div>

        <div class="card">
          <div class="ca" style="background:var(--sky)"></div>

          <div class="rri risk"><div class="rric">💸</div><div><div class="rrt">Interest Rate Sensitivity</div><div class="rrb">A 3% rate rise (APRA buffer) would add <strong id="rr-rate-delta">$xxx</strong>/month to repayments.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri risk"><div class="rric">🏚</div><div><div class="rrt">Hidden Structural Issues</div><div class="rrb">Unforeseen defects can blow the renovation budget. B&P inspection is essential.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri risk" id="rri-equity"><div class="rric">📉</div><div><div class="rrt">Low Equity Buffer</div><div class="rrb">With <span id="rr-dep-pct">2%</span> personal deposit, any market correction leaves little buffer.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri risk" id="rri-lmi-risk" style="display:none;"><div class="rric">💳</div><div><div class="rrt">LMI Required</div><div class="rrb">LVR above 80% triggers Lenders Mortgage Insurance — estimated <strong id="rr-lmi-est">$0</strong> added to your loan. Ask your lender about the First Home Guarantee to avoid this.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri risk"><div class="rric">🔨</div><div><div class="rrt">Reno Cost Blowouts</div><div class="rrb">Reno pool is <span id="rr-pool-val">$24k</span>. Scope creep and tradie delays can rapidly eat through this.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri risk" id="rri-overlap"><div class="rric">🏠</div><div><div class="rrt">Dual Housing Costs</div><div class="rrb">Paying <span id="rr-overlap-cost">$4k</span> in combined rent + mortgage during your <span id="rr-overlap-weeks">4</span>-week overlap reduces your reno buffer.</div></div></div>
        </div>

          <div class="rri reward"><div class="rric">🏠</div><div><div class="rrt">Into the Market Now</div><div class="rrb">With <span id="rr-dep-show">$13k</span> deposit you stop rent leakage and start building equity immediately.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri reward"><div class="rric">📈</div><div><div class="rrt">Renovation-Driven Equity</div><div class="rrb">A targeted <span id="rr-reno-show">$24k</span> reno on a <span id="rr-price-show">$650k</span> property can unlock $40k–$80k+ in uplift.</div></div></div>

          <div class="rri reward" id="rri-lmi"><div class="rric">🛡</div><div><div class="rrt">No LMI Required</div><div class="rrb">Avoiding Lenders Mortgage Insurance saves thousands in sunk costs.</div></div></div>
          <div class="rri reward"><div class="rric">💰</div><div><div class="rrt">Long-Term Capital Growth</div><div class="rrb">Your <span id="rr-dep-ltg">$13k</span> deposit on a <span id="rr-price-ltg">$650k</span> asset gives leveraged exposure to property appreciation.</div></div></div>

              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:22px;color:var(--sage);" id="yield-gross">—</div>
            </div>
            <div style="background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 12px;">
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--slate);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px;">Net Yield (est.)</div>
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:22px;color:var(--sage);" id="yield-net">—</div>
            </div>
            <div style="background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 12px;">
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--slate);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px;">Annual Rent</div>
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:22px;" id="yield-annual-rent">—</div>
            </div>
            <div style="background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border-radius:4px;padding:10px 12px;">
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--slate);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px;">Annual Cashflow</div>
              <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:22px;" id="yield-cashflow">—</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;" id="yield-verdict">—</div>
          <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;">Net yield deducts ~8% PM fees, $2k rates, $1.5k insurance, 1% maintenance. Cashflow = net rent − mortgage.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>

  </main>
</div>
</div>

<div id="pdf-options-modal" style="display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:6000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.65);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;">
  <div style="background:#F5F0E8;border-radius:8px;width:min(520px,96vw);max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);">
    <!-- Header -->

      <div>
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#C9A84C;margin-bottom:3px;">EXPORT</div>
        <div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:#F5F0E8;">Export Options</div>
      </div>

    </div>
    <!-- Body -->
    <div style="padding:22px;">

      <!-- Export Format -->
      <div style="margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A4A52;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);">Export Format</div>
        <div id="export-format-btns" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <button class="export-format-btn active" data-format="pdf" style="padding:9px 16px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:#1C1C1E;color:#C9A84C;font-weight:600;transition:all 0.15s;">PDF</button>
          <button class="export-format-btn" data-format="csv" style="padding:9px 16px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;color:#1C1C1E;transition:all 0.15s;">CSV</button>
          <button class="export-format-btn" data-format="html" style="padding:9px 16px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;color:#1C1C1E;transition:all 0.15s;">HTML</button>
          <button class="export-format-btn" data-format="txt" style="padding:9px 16px;border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);background:white;color:#1C1C1E;transition:all 0.15s;">TXT</button>
        </div>
        <div id="export-format-hint" style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;">Opens a printable report — use your browser's Print to save as PDF.</div>
      </div>

      <!-- Page Size & Orientation (PDF only) -->
      <div id="pdf-layout-section" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A4A52;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);">Page Layout</div>
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;">
          <div>
            <label style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:#4A4A52;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Page Size</label>
            <select id="pdf-opt-size" style="width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;background:white;color:#1C1C1E;cursor:pointer;">
              <option value="A4" selected>A4 (210 × 297 mm)</option>
              <option value="A3">A3 (297 × 420 mm)</option>
              <option value="Letter">US Letter (8.5 × 11 in)</option>
              <option value="Legal">US Legal (8.5 × 14 in)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:#4A4A52;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Orientation</label>
            <select id="pdf-opt-orient" style="width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;background:white;color:#1C1C1E;cursor:pointer;">
              <option value="portrait" selected>Portrait</option>
              <option value="landscape">Landscape</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Sections to include (PDF/HTML only) -->
      <div id="pdf-sections-section" style="margin-bottom:20px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A4A52;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);">Sections to Include</div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;">
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-financial" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Financial Snapshot</strong> — price, deposit, govt contribution, cash picture</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-reno" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Renovation Budget</strong> — pool, itemised costs, contingency</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-repay" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Loan Repayments</strong> — monthly, weekly, annual, total interest</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-amort" style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Amortisation Schedule</strong> — full year-by-year principal &amp; interest table</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-overlap" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Rent Overlap</strong> — weekly overlap cost, cash remaining</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-risks" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Risk &amp; Reward</strong> — risk/reward meter scores and descriptions</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-notes" checked style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Property Notes</strong> — your saved notes for this property</span></label>
          <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;"><input type="checkbox" id="pdf-opt-timeline" style="accent-color:#C9A84C;width:15px;height:15px;"> <span><strong>Purchase Timeline</strong> — phase-by-phase guide from offer to move-in</span></label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Appearance (PDF/HTML only) -->
      <div id="pdf-appearance-section" style="margin-bottom:22px;">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#4A4A52;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:5px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);">Appearance</div>
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;">
          <div>
            <label style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:#4A4A52;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Colour Scheme</label>
            <select id="pdf-opt-colour" style="width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;background:white;color:#1C1C1E;cursor:pointer;">
              <option value="full" selected>Full Colour</option>
              <option value="mono">Monochrome (ink saving)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;color:#4A4A52;display:block;margin-bottom:5px;">Font Size</label>
            <select id="pdf-opt-fontsize" style="width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;background:white;color:#1C1C1E;cursor:pointer;">
              <option value="normal" selected>Normal</option>
              <option value="large">Large (accessibility)</option>
              <option value="compact">Compact (fit more per page)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Action buttons -->
      <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button id="pdf-cancel-btn" style="padding:10px 18px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.07);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.15);border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;color:#1C1C1E;">Cancel</button>
        <button id="pdf-generate-btn" style="padding:10px 22px;background:#1C1C1E;border:none;border-radius:4px;font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;color:#C9A84C;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0.5px;">⬇ Export</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ══ TOP-RIGHT PROFILE WIDGET — rendered by auth-nav.js ══ -->
<div class="site-nav-actions" style="position:fixed;top:max(28px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 20px));right:28px;z-index:1900;"></div>

<script src="app.js" defer></script>
<script src="app-events.js" defer></script>
<script src="sw-register.js" defer></script>

</body>
</html>
```

## `blog-editor.html`

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-AU">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<script>try{if(localStorage.getItem("equitySight_theme")==="dark")document.documentElement.classList.add("dark-mode")}catch(e){}</script>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Blog Editor — EquitySight.app</title>
<meta name="description" content="EquitySight blog editor — admin only.">
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="favicon.svg">
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="favicon.svg">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preload" as="style" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400;500&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400;500&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="shared.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="admin.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="blog-editor.css">
</head>
<body>

<!-- Loading view -->
<div id="loading-view" class="be-loading">
  <div class="be-loading-text">Verifying access…</div>
</div>

<!-- Access denied -->
<div id="access-denied" class="be-access-denied" style="display:none;">
  <div class="be-access-icon">🔒</div>
  <h2>Access Restricted</h2>
  <p id="access-denied-msg">This page requires an admin account. Please sign in to continue.</p>
  <a href="/login" class="btn-admin" style="margin-top:4px;">Sign In</a>
</div>

<!-- Main editor layout (shown after auth) -->
<div id="editor-layout" style="display:none;flex:1;flex-direction:column;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;">

  <!-- Top bar -->
  <header class="be-topbar">
    <div class="be-topbar-brand">
      <!-- Mobile: toggle sidebar -->
      <button class="be-topbar-mobile-toggle btn-admin-outline" id="be-sidebar-toggle" style="font-size:11px;padding:5px 10px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.6);border-color:rgba(245,240,232,0.18);" title="Toggle post list">☰</button>
      <a href="/admin" id="be-back-link" class="be-back-btn">← Admin</a>
      <span class="be-brand-title">Blog Editor</span>
    </div>
    <div id="be-save-status" class="be-topbar-status"></div>
    <div class="be-topbar-actions">
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="blog-sync-github-btn" style="font-size:11px;padding:6px 12px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.7);border-color:rgba(245,240,232,0.2);" title="Push all published posts to GitHub (triggers auto-deploy)">Sync to GitHub</button>
      <button class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="blog-new-post-btn" style="font-size:11px;padding:6px 14px;">+ New Post</button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Body: sidebar + main -->
  <div class="be-body">

    <!-- Left sidebar: post list -->
    <aside class="be-sidebar" id="be-sidebar">
      <div class="be-sidebar-head">
        <div id="blog-stats" class="be-sidebar-stats">—</div>
        <div class="be-sidebar-btns">
          <button class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="blog-new-post-btn-2" style="font-size:10px;padding:5px 10px;flex:1;">+ New Post</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="blog-posts-list" class="be-posts-list">
        <div class="be-list-loading">Loading…</div>
      </div>
    </aside>

    <!-- Right: editor area -->
    <main class="be-main">

      <!-- Empty state (no post selected) -->
      <div id="be-empty" class="be-empty">
        <div class="be-empty-icon">✍️</div>
        <div class="be-empty-text">Select a post or click + New Post to begin</div>
      </div>

      <!-- Editor form -->
      <div id="blog-editor-form" class="be-editor" style="display:none;">

        <!-- Editor header row -->
        <div class="be-editor-head">
          <div id="blog-editor-title" class="be-editor-head-title">New Post</div>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="blog-editor-close-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:4px 10px;flex-shrink:0;">✕ Close</button>
        </div>

        <input type="hidden" id="blog-edit-id" value="">

        <!-- Scrollable: metadata + body -->
        <div class="be-editor-scroll">

          <!-- Core metadata (always visible) -->
          <div class="be-meta-core">
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Title *</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-title" placeholder="How the RBA cash rate actually affects your repayments">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Section (folder)</label>
              <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
                <select class="config-input" id="blog-edit-section" style="flex:1;">
                  <option value="general">General</option>
                </select>
                <button type="button" class="btn-admin-outline" id="be-section-new-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 10px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;" title="Create a new section">+ New</button>
              </div>
              <!-- New section input (hidden by default) -->
              <div id="be-section-create" style="display:none;margin-top:6px;display:none;">
                <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
                  <input type="text" class="config-input" id="be-section-name-input" placeholder="e.g. First Home Buyers" style="flex:1;">
                  <button type="button" class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="be-section-create-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 12px;white-space:nowrap;">Create</button>
                  <button type="button" class="btn-admin-outline" id="be-section-cancel-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 10px;">✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <!-- URL preview (full width) -->
            <div style="grid-column:1/-1;">
              <label class="config-label be-label">Post URL</label>
              <div id="be-url-preview" style="font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--slate);padding:7px 10px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);border-radius:4px;">/blog/general/your-post-title/</div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Excerpt (shown on blog card, 140–200 chars)</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-excerpt" placeholder="A short summary shown on the blog index and in the page meta description.">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Tags (comma-separated, max 6)</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-tags" placeholder="strategy, first-home-buyer">
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Post Settings toggle -->
          <button type="button" class="be-meta-toggle-btn" id="be-meta-toggle">
            <span class="be-meta-toggle-arrow">▸</span>
            Post Settings — author, cover image, SEO
          </button>

          <!-- Extended metadata (collapsible) -->
          <div id="be-meta-extra" class="be-meta-extra">
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Author name</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-author" placeholder="Alex Chen">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label class="config-label be-label">Cover / hero image (shown at top of post + blog cards)</label>
              <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;">
                <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-cover" placeholder="https://… paste an image URL" style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
                <div id="be-cover-preview" style="width:72px;height:46px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">
                  <img id="be-cover-thumb" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:none;" alt="Cover preview">
                  <span id="be-cover-placeholder" style="font-size:18px;opacity:0.3;">🖼</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="be-meta-extra-full">
              <label class="config-label be-label">Author bio (shown under the article)</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-author-bio" placeholder="Co-founder &amp; CTO. Former fintech engineer with …">
            </div>
            <div class="be-meta-extra-two">
              <label class="config-label be-label">SEO meta description (50–160 chars — falls back to excerpt if blank)</label>
              <input type="text" class="config-input" id="blog-edit-meta-desc" placeholder="Override the excerpt with a tighter search snippet.">
              <div id="blog-edit-metadesc-count" style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:3px;font-family:var(--font-mono);">0 chars</div>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;padding-top:22px;">
              <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--charcoal);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;">
                <input type="checkbox" id="blog-edit-featured" style="width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#C9A84C;">
                Featured on blog hero
              </label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Body editor -->
          <div class="be-body-area">
            <div class="be-body-toolbar">
              <span class="be-body-label">Body — Markdown</span>
              <button type="button" class="be-mode-btn active" id="blog-edit-mode-write">Write</button>
              <button type="button" class="be-mode-btn" id="blog-edit-mode-preview">Preview</button>
              <button type="button" class="be-mode-btn" id="blog-insert-image-btn" title="Insert an image into the body">🖼 Image</button>
              <div id="blog-edit-wordcount">0 words</div>
            </div>
            <!-- Inline image insert panel -->
            <div id="be-insert-image-panel" style="display:none;background:rgba(28,28,30,0.04);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);border-radius:4px;padding:8px 10px;margin-bottom:6px;flex-shrink:0;">
              <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
                <div>
                  <label class="be-label" style="margin-bottom:3px;">Image URL</label>
                  <input type="text" class="config-input" id="be-img-url" placeholder="https://… paste image URL" style="font-size:12px;">
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label class="be-label" style="margin-bottom:3px;">Alt text</label>
                  <input type="text" class="config-input" id="be-img-alt" placeholder="Describe the image" style="font-size:12px;">
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:5px;padding-top:16px;">
                  <button type="button" class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="be-img-insert-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 12px;white-space:nowrap;">Insert</button>
                  <button type="button" class="btn-admin-outline" id="be-img-cancel-btn" style="font-size:10px;padding:6px 8px;">✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style="font-size:10px;color:var(--slate);margin-top:5px;font-family:var(--font-mono);">Inserts <code style="background:rgba(28,28,30,0.07);padding:1px 4px;border-radius:2px;">![alt](url)</code> at the cursor position in the body.</div>
            </div>
            <textarea id="blog-edit-body" class="config-input" placeholder="## Introduction&#10;&#10;Write 1,500+ words here using Markdown…"></textarea>
            <div id="blog-edit-preview"></div>
          </div>

        </div><!-- /.be-editor-scroll -->

        <!-- Fixed action bar -->
        <div class="be-actions">
          <div id="blog-edit-status" class="be-status"></div>
          <button class="btn-admin btn-admin-primary" id="blog-save-draft-btn">Save draft</button>
          <button class="btn-admin" id="blog-save-publish-btn" style="background:#2e7d32;color:#fff;">Save &amp; Publish</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="blog-unpublish-btn" style="display:none;">Unpublish</button>
          <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="blog-delete-btn" style="color:#c62828;border-color:#c62828;display:none;">Delete</button>
        </div>

      </div><!-- /#blog-editor-form -->

    </main>
  </div><!-- /.be-body -->

</div><!-- /#editor-layout -->

<!-- Confirm dialog -->
<div id="be-confirm-overlay" class="be-confirm-overlay" style="display:none;">
  <div class="be-confirm-dialog">
    <div class="be-confirm-title" id="be-confirm-title">Confirm</div>
    <div class="be-confirm-msg" id="be-confirm-msg"></div>
    <div class="be-confirm-btns">
      <button class="btn-admin-outline" id="be-confirm-cancel">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn-admin" id="be-confirm-ok" style="background:#c62828;color:white;">Delete</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Toast -->
<div id="be-toast" class="be-toast" style="display:none;opacity:0;"></div>

<script src="error-capture.js"></script>
<script src="blog-editor.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<section class="contact-body" id="support">
  <div class="contact-inner">

    <!-- Support options -->

      <div class="section-tag">Get help fast</div>
      <h2 style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:26px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.2;">Support options</h2>
      <div class="support-options">

        <div class="support-card" style="cursor:pointer;">
          <div class="support-icon" style="background:rgba(201,168,76,0.12);">✉️</div>
          <div class="support-card-text">
            <h3>Email support</h3>
            <p>Send us a message about anything — account, billing, a bug, or a feature idea.</p>
            <p class="rt">Typical reply: &lt; 24 hours</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="support-card" style="cursor:pointer;">
          <div class="support-icon" style="background:rgba(91,143,171,0.12);">💬</div>
          <div class="support-card-text">
            <h3>Live chat</h3>
            <p>Available to Pro subscribers during business hours (AEST Mon–Fri).</p>
            <p class="rt">Pro plan feature</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="support-card" style="cursor:pointer;">
          <div class="support-icon" style="background:rgba(123,158,135,0.12);">📖</div>
          <div class="support-card-text">
            <h3>Documentation</h3>
            <p>Read how the shared equity calculator works, how scheme rules are applied, and how to interpret the 30-year chart.</p>
            <p class="rt">Always available</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="support-card">
          <div class="support-icon" style="background:rgba(196,112,74,0.12);">🐛</div>
          <div class="support-card-text">
            <h3>Report a bug</h3>
            <p>Found something broken? Use the form and select "Bug report" — we treat these as urgent and usually fix within 48 hours.</p>
            <p class="rt">See the form →</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

      <h2>Send us a message</h2>

      <div id="contact-form">

          <div class="cf-field"><label class="cf-label">First name</label><input class="cf-input" id="cf-fname" type="text" placeholder="Jamie"></div>
          <div class="cf-field"><label class="cf-label">Last name</label><input class="cf-input" id="cf-lname" type="text" placeholder="Smith"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="cf-field"><label class="cf-label">Email</label><input class="cf-input" id="cf-email" type="email" placeholder="demo@example.com"></div>
        <div class="cf-field">
          <label class="cf-label">Subject</label>
          <select class="cf-select" id="cf-subject">
            <option value="">Select a topic...</option>
            <option value="general">General question</option>
            <option value="bug">Bug report</option>
            <option value="feature">Feature request</option>
            <option value="billing">Billing / subscription</option>
            <option value="calculator">Calculator question</option>
            <option value="other">Other</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="cf-field"><label class="cf-label">Message</label><textarea class="cf-textarea" id="cf-message" placeholder="Tell us what's on your mind..."></textarea></div>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--slate);margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.5;">By submitting this form you agree to our <a href="/privacy" style="color:var(--gold);">Privacy Policy</a>. We'll only use your email to respond to your enquiry.</div>
        <button class="cf-submit" id="cf-submit">Send Message →</button>
        <div style="font-size:12px;color:#E8956A;margin-top:8px;min-height:18px;font-family:var(--font-mono);" id="cf-error"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="cf-success" id="cf-success">
        <div class="cf-success-icon">✅</div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--charcoal);margin-bottom:8px;">Message sent!</div>
        <div style="color:var(--slate);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:14px;">We'll get back to you within 24 hours. While you wait, try the calculator →</div>
        <button style="margin-top:20px;background:var(--charcoal);color:var(--cream);border:none;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0.5px;">Open Calculator →</button>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- FAQ -->
<section class="faq-section">
  <div class="faq-inner">
    <h2 style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:32px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:48px;text-align:center;">Common questions</h2>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">How does the shared equity calculator work?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">EquitySight models the government's equity contribution based on the scheme rules for your state (QLD, NSW, or VIC). It calculates the government's percentage share, what you'll owe when you sell or buy out, and how that changes over time as property values grow. It uses the purchase price, your savings, and the applicable income/property caps to determine eligibility.</div></div>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">Is EquitySight actually accurate?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">Our calculations are based on publicly available scheme rules and standard mortgage calculations. They're designed to give you an accurate planning picture, not a legal quote. Always verify eligibility and final figures with a licensed mortgage broker or financial adviser before making any decisions.</div></div>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">I'm having trouble logging in — what do I do?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">Try clearing your browser cache and logging in again. If that doesn't work, use the "forgot password" option on the login page. If you're still stuck, send us a message using the form above with "Billing / subscription" selected and we'll sort it out promptly.</div></div>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">How do I cancel my subscription?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">Go to Account Settings → Subscription → Cancel Plan. Your Pro access will continue until the end of the billing period. We don't charge cancellation fees. If you cancel mid-year on an annual plan and want a partial refund, contact us.</div></div>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">Can I use this on my phone?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">Yes — EquitySight is fully responsive and works well on iPhone and Android. You can also add it to your home screen as a PWA (Progressive Web App) for a native-app-like experience. On iPhone: tap Share → Add to Home Screen. On Android: tap the menu → Install App.</div></div>

    <div class="faq-item"><button class="faq-q">Do you have an API for developers?<span class="faq-ico">+</span></button><div class="faq-ans">An API is planned, starting with the Adviser plan. If you have a specific integration in mind, send us a message — we'd love to hear what you're building.</div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<div id="site-footer-root"></div>
<script src="footer.js"></script>

<script src="contact.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!-- ── Why Australian buyers choose EquitySight (long-form content block) ── -->
<section class="why-aus" id="why-australian-buyers">
  <div class="why-aus-inner">
    <div class="section-tag">Built for Australia</div>
    <h2 class="why-aus-h2">Why Australian property buyers use EquitySight</h2>
    <div class="why-aus-grid">
      <div class="why-aus-col">
        <h3>The 2025-26 Australian property market is unforgiving</h3>
        <p>Rising interest rates, APRA's 3% serviceability buffer, and record-high median prices in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane mean buyers need to model every cost before making an offer. The difference between the First Home Guarantee, FHOG and state stamp duty concessions can be tens of thousands of dollars — and it's different in every state.</p>
        <p>EquitySight is an Australian property finance calculator built specifically for these conditions. Every formula uses current-year ATO individual tax rates, APRA Prudential Standard APS 220, state revenue office stamp duty schedules, and Melbourne Institute HEM benchmarks — not a US mortgage calculator repurposed with AUD.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="why-aus-col">
        <h3>State-specific rules, baked in</h3>
        <p>Our stamp duty, FHOG and first home buyer concession rules cover all eight Australian states and territories (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT). The borrowing power calculator applies the APRA 3% buffer every major lender uses. The capital gains tax calculator applies the 50% discount for 12-month-plus holds at your marginal rate, with the correct FY2025-26 Medicare levy sliding-scale.</p>
        <p>The <a href="/tools">full 14-calculator suite</a> takes you from deposit planning through to sale. If you want one tool that combines them all — scenario saving, 30-year projections, PDF export — the <a href="/app">EquitySight full calculator</a> is free to start.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="why-aus-methodology">Every number is documented. Read our <a href="/methodology">full methodology</a> — every formula, threshold and assumption — and <a href="/data-sources">data sources</a> including ABS 2021 Census, RBA cash rate history, and state revenue offices.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ── Landing FAQ (schema.org FAQPage — renders as Google rich result) ── -->
<section class="landing-faq" id="faq">
  <div class="landing-faq-inner">
    <div class="section-tag" style="text-align:center;">Frequently asked</div>
    <h2 class="landing-faq-h2">Australian property finance, answered</h2>
    <div class="landing-faq-list">
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>How much deposit do I actually need to buy a home in Australia?</summary>
        <p>The standard benchmark is <strong>20% of the purchase price</strong> to avoid Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). You can buy with as little as 5% via the First Home Guarantee, or 10% with LMI capitalised onto the loan. On a $650,000 property that's $32,500 through the First Home Guarantee versus $130,000 for a full 20% deposit — plus 3–5% for stamp duty, conveyancing and inspections. Use the <a href="/tools/deposit-calculator">deposit calculator</a> to see the exact number for your target price and state.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>What stamp duty do I pay in NSW, VIC or QLD?</summary>
        <p>Stamp duty (transfer duty) is levied by each state revenue office and varies significantly. NSW first home buyers pay $0 on properties under $800,000 and a concessional rate up to $1,000,000. VIC offers an exemption up to $600,000 and a concession to $750,000. QLD increased its First Home Owner Grant to $30,000 in May 2024 and exempts stamp duty on new homes under $700,000. Our <a href="/tools/stamp-duty-calculator">Australian stamp duty calculator</a> covers all 8 states (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT) with current FY2025-26 rates.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>How much can an Australian bank lend me?</summary>
        <p>Lenders calculate borrowing power from your net disposable income minus assessed expenses (the higher of your declared costs or the Household Expenditure Measure) minus existing debt repayments — all stress-tested at your current interest rate plus APRA's 3% serviceability buffer. A household on $120,000 with $3,500/month expenses and no debts typically qualifies for a $550,000–$650,000 loan. Run the numbers with our <a href="/tools/borrowing-power-calculator">borrowing power calculator</a> — it applies the APRA buffer every major lender uses.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>What is the APRA 3% serviceability buffer and why does it matter?</summary>
        <p>APRA (the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority) requires every Australian lender to assess loan serviceability at the actual interest rate <em>plus 3 percentage points</em>, under Prudential Standard APS 220. If your real rate is 6.25%, the bank models repayments at 9.25%. This buffer exists to protect borrowers from future rate rises — it's been at 3% since October 2021. It's the single biggest reason banks lend less than borrowers expect, and every calculator on this site applies it transparently.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>LMI vs FHOG — what's the difference?</summary>
        <p><strong>Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI)</strong> is insurance the lender takes out (but you pay for) when your deposit is below 20%. It protects the lender if you default. Premiums run $8,000–$25,000+ depending on loan size and LVR. <strong>First Home Owner Grant (FHOG)</strong> is a state government cash grant for first home buyers purchasing a new build: NSW/VIC/WA/NT $10,000, QLD $30,000, SA $15,000, TAS $20,000, ACT $0. LMI is a cost; FHOG is a contribution. Our <a href="/tools/first-home-buyer-grants-calculator">FHB grants calculator</a> shows exactly what you qualify for in your state.</p>
      </details>
      <details class="landing-faq-item">
        <summary>How does EquitySight work — what data sources power the calculators?</summary>
        <p>Every formula is documented. Stamp duty schedules come from each state revenue office (<a href="https://www.revenue.nsw.gov.au/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NSW</a>, <a href="https://www.sro.vic.gov.au/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">VIC</a>, <a href="https://www.revenue.qld.gov.au/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">QLD</a> etc.), tax rates from the <a href="https://www.ato.gov.au/rates/individual-income-tax-rates/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ATO individual income tax rates</a>, the serviceability buffer from APRA's APS 220, cash-rate data from the <a href="https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/cash-rate/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">RBA</a>, and suburb demographics from the <a href="https://www.abs.gov.au/census" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ABS 2021 Census</a>. Full detail in our <a href="/methodology">methodology</a> and <a href="/data-sources">data sources</a> pages.</p>
      </details>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

    <p>Every calculator on EquitySight derives its numbers from primary Australian government sources — not scraped blog aggregates. Stamp duty and first home buyer concession schedules are pulled direct from each state revenue office. Individual income tax brackets and the Medicare levy shading-in thresholds track the ATO's published rates for the current financial year. Borrowing power applies APRA's Prudential Standard APS 220 serviceability buffer. Suburb population, median income, and dwelling mix come from the ABS 2021 Census. Live cash-rate context references the RBA's statistical tables.</p>
```

```javascript
// about-init.js — Load custom about page content if admin has edited it
(function(){
  try {
    var stored = localStorage.getItem('propCalc_aboutPage_v1');
    if(stored) {
      var data = JSON.parse(stored);
      if(data.heroH1) document.getElementById('about-h1').innerHTML = data.heroH1;
      if(data.heroLead) document.getElementById('about-lead').textContent = data.heroLead;
      if(data.storyH2) document.getElementById('about-story-h2').textContent = data.storyH2;
      if(data.storyP1) document.getElementById('about-story-p1').textContent = data.storyP1;
    }
  } catch(e) {}
})();
```

## `account-panel.js`

```javascript
/**
 * EquitySight.app — Standalone Account Settings Panel
 * Self-injects HTML/CSS and exposes window.openAccountPanel / closeAccountPanel.
 * Included automatically by auth-nav.js on every page except app.html
 * (which has the panel built-in).
 */
(function () {
  if (document.getElementById('ap-panel')) return; // already present

  var SESSION_KEY  = 'propCalc_session_v1';
  var PROFILE_BASE = 'propCalc_profile_v1';
  var AP_COLORS    = ['#C9A84C','#7B9E87','#5B8FAB','#C4704A','#C45A5A','#8B6FAE','#4A9E8A','#B0956E'];

  function getSession()  { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)); }  catch(e) { return null; } }
  function getProfileKey(){ var s = getSession(); return PROFILE_BASE + '_' + (s && (s.id || s.userId) || 'guest'); }
  function getProfile()  { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(getProfileKey())) || {}; } catch(e) { return {}; } }
  function saveProfile(p){ localStorage.setItem(getProfileKey(), JSON.stringify(p)); }
  function isLoggedIn(){ var s = getSession(); return !!(s && s.id); }
  // Only allow data:image/* (from canvas) or https:// URLs in photo src attributes
  function safePhotoSrc(url) {
    if (!url) return null;
    if (/^data:image\/(jpeg|png|gif|webp);base64,/.test(url)) return url;
    try { var u = new URL(url); return u.protocol === 'https:' ? url : null; } catch(e) { return null; }
  }

  // ── Inject CSS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var style = document.createElement('style');
  style.textContent = [
    '#ap-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3000;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.5);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);}',
    '#ap-overlay.open{display:block;}',
    '#ap-panel{position:fixed;top:0;right:-480px;width:min(480px,100vw);height:100vh;',
      'background:var(--warm-white,#F5F3EE);z-index:3001;overflow-y:auto;',
      'transition:right 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);',
      'box-shadow:-8px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);',
      'padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);}',
    '#ap-panel.open{right:0;}',
    '.ap2-header{background:#1C1C1E;color:#F5F0E8;padding:16px 20px;',
      'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;',
      'position:sticky;top:0;z-index:1;}',
    '.ap2-header h2{font-family:"DM Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;',
      'text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.7);margin:0;}',
    '.ap2-close{width:32px;height:32px;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08);',
      'border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:4px;color:#F5F0E8;',

    '.ap2-body{padding:24px;}',

      'padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.1);}',

    '.ap2-input{width:100%;background:var(--warm-white,#F5F3EE);border:1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.12);',

    '.ap2-input:focus{border-color:rgba(201,168,76,0.6);background:white;}',
    '.ap2-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}',

    '.ap2-btn-primary{background:#1C1C1E;color:#F5F0E8;}.ap2-btn-primary:hover{opacity:0.85;}',
    '.ap2-btn-gold{background:#C9A84C;color:#1C1C1E;}.ap2-btn-gold:hover{opacity:0.88;}',

      'border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,0.3);background:rgba(201,168,76,0.08);color:#C9A84C;}',
    '.ap2-color-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px;}',

      'border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform 0.15s,border-color 0.15s;}',
    '.ap2-swatch:hover,.ap2-swatch.active{transform:scale(1.2);border-color:white;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);}',
    /* ── Dark mode overrides ── */
    'html.dark-mode #ap-panel{background:#111113!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-card{background:#1C1C1E!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.09)!important;color:#F5F0E8!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-section-title{color:rgba(245,240,232,0.4)!important;border-bottom-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.07)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-label{color:rgba(245,240,232,0.45)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-input{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.11)!important;color:#F5F0E8!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-input:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.09)!important;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,0.5)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-btn-primary{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1)!important;color:#F5F0E8!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-btn-primary:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-status.ok{background:rgba(90,158,123,0.15)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-status.err{background:rgba(196,90,90,0.15)!important;}',
    'html.dark-mode #ap-panel p,html.dark-mode #ap-panel span:not(.ap2-plan-badge):not(.scheme-pill){color:inherit;}',
    /* Plan badge & inline text inside cards */
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-card *{color:inherit;}',
    'html.dark-mode .ap2-plan-badge{background:rgba(201,168,76,0.12)!important;border-color:rgba(201,168,76,0.3)!important;color:#C9A84C!important;}'
  ].join('');
  document.head.appendChild(style);

  // ── Inject HTML ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.id = 'ap-overlay';
  overlay.onclick = function () { window.closeAccountPanel(); };
  document.body.appendChild(overlay);

  var panel = document.createElement('div');
  panel.id = 'ap-panel';
  panel.innerHTML = [
    '<div class="ap2-header">',
```
